reviews.text: I recommend the clinic to everyone with the warmest of hearts. Our puppy, Nózi, was in a very bad condition when we came to them. Not only did they help her with great expertise, but they also supported me mentally throughout. I would like to especially thank Mónika Vajda for her extraordinary kindness and wonderful attitude! Thank God we are over the difficult time, Nózi is fine. An incredibly kind and humane team, thank you very much for everything! 🐶❣️

My cat swallowed a meter of Christmas ribbon, and they took me out of turn as an emergency, I got the ribbon back within 1.5 hours, they managed to remove it in time, without surgery, everything has been fine since then, probably if they hadn't taken me as an emergency, it wouldn't have been such a simple case

During a procedure costing nearly three hundred thousand forints, when I had to spend half a day in the office, the doctor called me into the operating room twice and then rushed off to do something else without saying a word! On one occasion, he served another client instead of me. He didn't even say, "Excuse me, God forbid, or do I allow this!" He just left me in the operating room, where there wasn't even a chair to sit on, to stand there for half an hour with a dog in my arms!!! Let's say you have to sit on wooden benches for 3-4 hours in the waiting room, they don't give you a miserable pillow under your butt! For 300,000 forints! Impudence

Oh my God, this place is crazy expensive!!!! 10-year-old home examination, without imaging, in short: antibiotics, hemostatics, painkillers, 1 tablet of pain and inflammation reliever, a hemostatic ampoule medicine for home, 1 syringe for blood sampling, and a multi-panel blood lab, this is then 134,000 HUF. Our cat had a nosebleed, in principle the only way to burn the vein is under anesthesia, according to the doctor, an endoscopy is needed (I don't know why) this is then an offer between 150-350 HUF. It would cost half a million HUF. We couldn't afford the latter!! Neither fracture, nor tumor, we brought in a nasal speculum with bleeding.
It takes a lot of money here!!!!!!!
Where do we live if a person has a cat, then at least 200-300 thousand HUF should be in reserve if the cat is sick????

Unfortunately, I don't have a good experience with this place. My dog ​​had been licking his back leg for some reason, so we took him to the vet. The doctor took out a needle and started poking the wound on his leg, saying there was a splinter in it. There was nothing in it. Then he prescribed him a painkiller and an antibiotic and bandaged the wound that he had poked. I wouldn't have any problem with that, but the thing is that they billed me 55,000 HUF for the operation. About a year ago, I was there for the same thing with another leg of this same dog, which was bleeding a lot because it stepped on something. We didn't pay 4,000 HUF then - not even a total of 4,000 HUF, because of a much bigger problem. I think that the doctor should tell the client before touching it that the fee will be this high and then the client can decide whether to proceed. But we are in Hungary... Anything is possible here.

What kind of specialist Faluvégi is, we didn't find out, but I say thank God. We went with a dog with a suspected toxemia in the nose last night around 6, (Aug. 21), he didn't take us in because he didn't fit in the time. OK, no problem. Just by looking at him, he said that he needed an endoscopy and deep anesthesia. When I asked for a price, he didn't answer - he would write it down in a text message. In the evening, I told him that we would go in the morning at the agreed time and that he would write down the price, as we had agreed. He didn't, until morning. In fact, I asked him about the price a total of 3 times. He was almost 40 minutes late for the agreed time, he answered the next patient's text message, he didn't even look at mine(!). The first thing he did when we went in was to register, he only blurted out the price when I asked him again.
It will be 280 thousand. The problem is not that it's so expensive because there is free pricing, but the STYLE and the crap, CHEATING! Why can't you openly say a price from to? Oh and you can only pay in kp, all this in 2026, a joke. It seems that they only care about money, nothing else. We came and looked for something else.
I don't recommend it.

We left nearly a million forints in the clinic (plus the costs we paid at another vet after the “treatment” here).

There was NO clear communication about prices. Of course, it can be said that this depends on the procedure, but it is not realistic at all that the interval related to this can cover differences of several hundred thousand forints.

We received the kitten back in a terrible condition after the procedure, which they said was a normal, dazed state. I am not attaching the picture just to avoid disturbing the peace. After the surgery, the assistants did not know whether the kitten had been given an alarm or not. Furthermore, there was no agreement on what happened before the surgery.
Let’s not even mention that the ultrasound of the heart that we specifically requested was not performed, when we received a verbal promise to do so at the beginning, saying “the kitten was wild”.

On top of all this, the clip on our plastic carrier broke during the treatment, making it a potential accident hazard. They are not willing to pay for the damage, they just want to repair the broken plastic, which is not safe at all for an animal carrier. It is ridiculous and pathetic that a place that operates at such a price level and advertises itself as a professional clinic would question paying for a carrier they destroyed without question. (Just to be clear to everyone, we sent a product that matched the damaged carrier at one price, and the answer was that there is a cheaper one. There is. But ours was not. )
All in all, we have ended communication with them, but we will not leave the matter at that.

Thank you very much for the fast and professional laparoscopic procedure! Thanks to this, my cat Vilmos was purring in the evening, eating delicious snacks, and his good mood returned.
Thank you to the entire team for their professional work!
Midling Anikó
We are very grateful that my son Loki was cured of a dental problem in almost no time. Everyone was very kind and professional.

We thought that no one would be able to help, even though the situation was very urgent,
As soon as the problem was discovered, we were immediately referred to Dr. András Faluvégi, who treated me and my little cat with great competence and empathy!
I am incredibly grateful that they saved our cat! Their expertise is beyond doubt🩷

A kind of drawn-out contradiction, the crisis is raging, but the show has to go on… My dog ​​inhaled a box of pus at midnight, appointments are full, life-saving surgeries. I arrived in the morning to find that the vet had found blood, so all I needed was that endoscope. The cute smiling assistants could only make an appointment for the next day in theory. Finally, we negotiate a consultation. The doctor is polite, he accepts last. I take the dog in to be anesthetized. I can also see a cute beagle puppy, on syrup. But let's wait, the Dr. comes out, let's talk about the details… The dog is peeing, papers are signed. I get an obscene amount from this position. The money is not the concern, I will pay it anyway, the tableware… After all, with twenty years of experience, if you don't take blood from my dog ​​every month, I'm a pretty bad person, hm. I don't draw blood every month without a medical reason... Somehow, all of them have survived the average age of their species or have passed it. But this is obviously blind luck. Later, the nurse enthusiastically waves the "prize" in the little bag and a tiny black gyut. I wait, they only let me go with instructions. That little thing was earwax, she took it out, she was happy to! Thirty thousand forints is added to the bill. I received no "instructions" for the medicines I received, either verbally or in writing. At the same time, the assistant lady in front of me gets a friendly nudge to look at the bill carefully, after all, all the items have to be in place! "Humans are basically lazy and selfish, they need to be motivated, financially stimulated. That's why capitalism works alone in the world, free competition, free competition of businesses."

Our dog had a lump in his nose, so we visited the clinic, and they were the only ones in the country who undertook the procedure on our small, elderly and heart-diseased dog within a short time. I wholeheartedly recommend the Gizmók team, Dr. Faluvégi was incredibly professional and thorough, very kind, humane and very patient with our otherwise not very cooperative dog. 😅 He took the time not only for us, but for everyone in the clinic and explained everything thoroughly and answered our questions, all on a Sunday evening, so that several people arrived after us and they were sure to have a long night. The assistants were also very kind to each and every one of them. It is indeed not cheap, but we stayed within the previously agreed price, even though more examinations were needed than planned due to the dog's age and known illness, but this way it was possible to safely put him to sleep. I wholeheartedly recommend them, I felt that our dog was in good hands the whole time.

The clinic itself is well equipped, the doctor is well prepared and professional...but. There are 4 clinics and one doctor was running from clinic to clinic, we had to wait 3 hours and it was all very expensive, they were driving us from right to left, just so it wouldn't be noticeable that 1 doctor was going to the 4 clinics. I'm not giving 1 star because they helped the dog. The doctor smiled really cheaply and said that the bill was under a million, which isn't that bad. It's a shame for a veterinarian to say something like that with a smile to someone whose savings are half a year's worth of vet bills.

We arrived on time, and after a 2-hour wait we were allowed in. My dog ​​was in my hands the whole time, the doctor (Dr. András Faluvégi) did not examine him, suggested a blood test, and very kindly informed me that since there would be a blood test, the examination fee would be “only” 20,000 instead of 30,000. Which never happened. Since we went with a suspicion of tracheal stenosis, I also asked for an X-ray. The result of this was not mentioned in the final report, so I called them to be kind enough to replace it and send the X-ray as well! I notified them several times over the course of 2 months that I had not received the scan, and I always get the answer that it will be sent today. For me, it is also questionable whether an X-ray was actually taken. What was very disturbing during our stay was that many people work there, but you have no idea who is who? Who is the doctor, who is the cleaner, they do not wear a name tag.

Dr. András Faluvégi and his team were incredibly professional. Our elderly dog ​​was treated with the utmost care and we felt he was in the best hands. I can recommend him to everyone with a clear heart.

Dear Gizmók company managers/owners!
We have been coming to you for 4 years, we have always received professional care, expensive, but quality. I have no problem with that. My only observation, which has been in my mind for a long time, is that even if you get an appointment, you always have to wait 30-45 minutes plus. Occasionally, there have been examples of 1-2 hours. I understand that there are urgent cases, surgical complications, delays, but in such cases, the waiting people are never informed. It has been like this for years, it has made sense to me so far, I was also thinking about whether to write a review. I am saying goodbye to you here, I am looking for another clinic where they pay attention to such small things. It matters a lot!

Thank you very much for the work of Dr András Faluvégi and Dr Verena Flanter. We arrived in Budapest from the countryside, our puppy sniffed a cat litter. We didn't know where to turn, we were rejected in several places. The Gizmók team welcomed me immediately, and after a short wait, they treated my dog. The whole team was very helpful and kind. We would like to thank them for their work!

Expertise and humanity are EXCELLENT!

Impy and I owe a huge debt of gratitude to Dr. András Faluvégi and the team at Gizmók Veterinary Center.

We visited 3 other veterinarians, including a larger clinic. We mentioned several times that we suspected stagnant stomach or intestinal contents, so many X-rays were taken of the dog that it glowed slowly in the dark, but no one did anything but prescribe medication.

Finally, after a difficult day, I visited the doctor at night, saying that the dog suspected of having an obstruction. He was willing to help us, and he performed an endoscopic examination at night, where he found no stomach contents, but signs of severe inflammation. He recommended treatment, which did not help.

Impy ate until the vomiting had a calming effect, then the agony began again, which led to an ultrasound examination. The ultrasound wasn't clear, but he could see that there was something in the colon that didn't belong there. He recommended exploratory surgery, during which he removed a large piece of k9 bell the size of half a palm.

We left grateful, happy, and ALIVE!

We noticed something was seriously wrong with our cat over the weekend and we wanted to bring him to this clinic at all costs, since they are closed on Saturdays, so we took him to a "foreign" place on Sunday morning in such a condition that he could even walk and eat before the treatment there. I don't blame the doctor, because he wanted to help, but after he treated him, he couldn't even lift his head and couldn't walk or eat. We were sure that we were losing the dearest thing in our lives and on Monday we rushed here to see if they could do a miracle. We thought every day that this would be the last and we were grateful for every day. They treated him with the greatest expertise and empathy for 5 days, even when it seemed unlikely that he would recover, since he is 22 years old and we had already brought him to them in a bedridden state. Tonight our little old good friend is here with us, he can already walk and has an appetite and just like the doctors, neither our cat nor we ever gave up. They did so much for him that I thought we wouldn't eat anymore this year, the total amount would be so huge, but the fantastic expertise here is affordable and it would have been worth it even if they had just given us an extra day with him, since many of us were waiting to go home.❤️
I do not recommend it to anyone!!!!!!!!!

We owe our gratitude and thanks to Dr. András Faluvégi and the entire team! We found competent hands and compassionate hearts.❤️...

We are in the fortunate position that until now, we have only met a veterinarian when we went for mandatory vaccinations.
However, recently, on Sunday evening, they saved our 12-year-old dog without sparing time or energy!
The whole process was incredibly fast, professional and efficient. The Doctor had everything in his hands the whole time and it was noticeable that we had found competent hands and compassionate hearts.❤️ All necessary tests were completed quickly. The surgery went well. I was also very kindly received during the control and infusion the next day. While we were there, the nurses and workers there came several times to check if everything was okay and they always had time for a reassuring pat. The suture removal was done in a matter of moments. The information was clear and comprehensive, which I would also like to thank you for once again, because it made the whole process much easier to know what to expect when.

Dömpi is now well, thanks to András and the team! ❤️
We are grateful for you!

I can only recommend them!
My friend's dog was euthanized because of a swallowed ball and wouldn't give it up. He managed to get it out so he didn't have to cut it. Respect! 😊 …

A doctor from another emergency dog ​​hospital recommended this animal-loving, knowledgeable, helpful GIZMÓK Hospital and Pharmacy! They are well-equipped, with special diagnostic equipment, their own lab, who examine even in emergencies without major incisions, evaluate the results in detail, and if necessary, operate immediately.
My dog ​​Léna weighs 52 kilos, she has not been sedated yet. She was growling badly with her huge body, which the knowledgeable hands easily moved as needed, calming her down, and stroking her. If I were them, I would have run away, because her mouth is full of huge teeth...
The doctor and his assistant took care of us with the same enthusiasm, patience, and love even after working hours, even though it was our first time meeting, our first time in trouble, and they did their job without saying a word. In fact, they were happy to help.
Down with the funnel crown in front of them!
Thank you:
to the owner and Léna, the guard dog
During the day we were at the Doctor's office, his expertise and kindness were outstanding. He also readily accepted us on Sunday in an emergency. He also gave us advice.🥰🤗 …

Hello! Yesterday our 14 year old Yorkie dog had surgery, 2 tumors were removed and her uterus. I would like to thank the clinic and Dr. András Faluvégi for their excellent work. The dog is doing great! Thank you!

A large-scale slaughterhouse, they only care about money, not the dog.
No correct information, just rushing. 😢 …

After a year and a half, I can write about it. I had a 15 and a half year old pug. He had old age diseases, he had all kinds of tests, MRI: dementia, ventricular dilatation, according to the examining doctor, it could be treated well for a very long time. When I sent the results to B.B., our doctor at the time, he also had this opinion.
I don't know what protocol they followed, but after administering the prescribed medications, my administrative, inspection dog specifically fell off his feet.
Let's reduce this medication, increase it. Then, during one of the check-ups, he gave him dry food, saying that he was very good. In vain did I say that my dog ​​doesn't eat dry food. He started making strange noises on the treatment table, which he waved at, even though I told him to. (My fault, I could have knocked B.B.'s head off so that he wouldn't dare give it to him, but it happened very quickly). We were already on Lehel Road at night because Boris couldn't breathe, he got pneumonia from the food he swallowed. After that, I called B.B. several times on the phone, he was never available, and then, when I was hysterically raging, the doctor answered the assistant quite aggressively (did he think I couldn't hear him on the phone?) that we should increase the diuretic then. And the last time, when I took him for an infusion, he didn't even say hello, he called in another patient, he didn't even look at us, even though we went to see him for an appointment.
I took care of Boris for 15 and a half years, he was my perfect companion, my Daimon, and the doctor I trusted got rid of him in 2 weeks.

The doctor is normal and qualified, there is no problem with that. The surgery is chaos, however, I received an appointment by email and confirmed by phone that it was Monday 11. The website states that the surgery opens at 11 = I would have been the first patient. We entered at 10:58 for a +250e forint surgery and there were already 3 animals in the operating room. By the time they called me in and I finally spoke to the doctor, it was 11:45. I told them politely that it is unethical to make someone wait almost 1 hour for an appointment, only to be told that they do not have a fixed time for surgery. However, it is different in email and different on the phone..it is complete chaos. Either there should be a queue number and whoever comes first should see it or they should stick to their appointments, but there is no order anywhere. The secretary tells me on the phone that the surgery is 1 hour and lasts from 11 to 12, and you can go at 12. I asked directly. The doctor tells me to come back at 4 o'clock at 11:45... I tell him what 4 is?? 1 was communicated and that turned into 4 and now 12 and dog surgery is not even close. The doctor says you have to listen to what the doctor says. I say ok but the secretary says otherwise, then you should teach him to know what is what or to talk to customers in person and give the correct information. The doctor tells me to go back to 2 then. Well I went back to 2 and at 245 I ask what is happening because the doctor said to come back to 2. The secretary tells me he is finishing now so it will take 30 minutes. But if he started at 12 and the surgery is 1 hour then how is he still in the operating room at 245??? Obviously he didn't start at 12... so chaos is the return. Almost 300 for the surgery and I don't regret the good and comfort from my dog ​​but I do regret the honesty from others. My time is valuable and no one wants to wait 45 minutes in the morning and 45 minutes in the afternoon because they said both times, I didn't come up with them. No apology, no discount, no excuse.
After the surgery, the doctor didn't even come out to tell me what the surgery was like and what to take and how and for how long..nothing..!!!
Outrageous
I almost had to beg to be able to pay because only the doctor knows that and he didn't come out. It was ridiculous

This system is really not right.
They love animals, I see, but the business part and the policies; are very weak. I don't recommend

Very kind, helpful, professional team. Süti was unwell, we noticed a needle in her mouth that we couldn't get out. We called at 2 am, the Doctor was on duty, he asked for an X-ray, which they did for us at another hospital (where we managed to get to quickly the first time), from then on we communicated with the Doctor. They reassured us a little here. Early in the morning, they managed to remove it from her stomach with an endoscope. This speed, helpfulness, professionalism was very reassuring, we knew she was in good hands, and we brought her to the right place. Thank you very much to everyone 🙏🏼❤️

Hello! Brülika the cat is writing here 🐾
I would like to say a huge thank you to the clinic and Dr. András Faluvégi for giving me a chance at life!

I am a special cat: I don’t have a nose, so it’s much harder for me than for other cats. Several clinics in Budapest didn’t take on my treatment because they thought my case was too complicated and they thought it couldn’t be helped anyway.

But Dr. András wasn’t afraid of me. He examined me thoroughly, started my treatment, and is making sure my little heart beats and my lungs work more easily.

I would also like to thank the entire team! Thank you for helping me, taking care of me, and putting up with my complicated little cat nature 😼💙
Thanks to you, I am eating, playing, purring again, and I can hope to live a long, happy life with those who love me.

Thank you for your expertise, patience, kind hands and big heart.
You are the true saviors of small, troubled, mustachioed lives. ❤️🐱

Tail in the high, purring gratefully:
noseless Brülika kitten 💙🐾

Dear András!
I hope you read the reviews:)
It's been 4 days since my dog, 2.2kg, 3-year-old Biewer Yorkie, has been unwell
We took him in on Sunday evening because we were sent there, as they are doing an urgent endoscopy, I had to explain everything 3 times before he understood what the problem was, and he also received a medical certificate from the previous veterinary hospital. He said he would sedate him and then put him to sleep, all this in my hands... After the endoscopy was finished, as soon as he woke up, we had to take him home... a normal person doesn't send a puppy home right after anesthesia. The next day we had to take him back to get an IV, which would have taken all day, but we brought him back after 2 hours of IV, but thank God we found someone else who enlightened me, because András only looked at one thing, because if a puppy is already anesthetized, why would he check if everything is okay? 😀 Let's put him to sleep 5 times, to make sure he's either dead or not wake up
Everything he did was completely wrong, he didn't diagnose his real problem at all, with that much force he could have died for the 320 thousand, and the point here is not the money, but the fact that for that much we didn't get anything tangible from the doctor

Dear András, you're worth as much as a piece of shit, thank you for nothing, a really good doctor, I wish they would sedate you too, although it wouldn't be much use, because basically it's like he's sedated.

I am most grateful to the team at Gizmók Veterinary Clinic and Pharmacy, especially Dr. András Faluvégi, for saving the life of my dog, Bellus.
They took us out of line when Bellus was already drowning, and immediately and with great expertise performed the life-saving intervention.

Dr. András Faluvégi is not only an excellent doctor, but also a true person who works with his heart and soul.
His attitude, empathy and kindness are a rare treasure - Bellus can now breathe again and can be with us for a little while longer, for which I will be forever grateful.

I can only recommend the clinic to everyone, where, in addition to professional knowledge, real love and care await the animals. 💕
Thank you for operating on our dog so quickly and precisely ❤️❤️❤️🥰 very kind and helpful nurses and doctors work here, thank you very much to everyone! I can only recommend the clinic to everyone …

I am very grateful to the team at Gizmók Veterinary Center!
The clinic is extremely well-equipped, modern and tastefully designed.
The doctors (I think we visited everyone) are incredibly thorough, patient, and pay maximum attention not only to the pets, but also to the owners.
My dog ​​was treated with complete dedication, and thanks to the immediate care, he fortunately recovered from pancreatitis.
I would like to thank them especially for the attention and care we received during the treatments, it was truly reassuring.
I can only recommend them!

I can provide proof of the appointment if needed.

I visited this clinic in June 2023 with my cat Bonita, who had allergies and an ear infection. The vet insisted on a video-otoscopy under anesthesia without informing us of the risks.

After the procedure, my cat developed neurological symptoms that have not fully resolved. She refused to eat, and I had to feed her with a syringe. The vet explained this as “increased sensitivity of British cats to anesthesia,” which is not true. My cat lost 1 kg over six months, and she was not fully examined before the procedure.

The procedure revealed nothing but caused harm to my cat. I do not recommend this clinic — they overcharge, lie, and put pets at risk.

I left the clinic with deep sadness because it was not possible to help our puppy.
But I consider it important to write my opinion, because what I experienced there is not everyday! Dr. András Faluvégi and his colleagues did everything they could to help our puppy Lilin. Before the intervention began, I received very detailed and precise, and by the way, understandable information from the doctor about what to expect!
They kept me informed, I never felt like I was left on my own.
All the nurses I met, without exception, showed such kindness and empathy that I had no doubt that we had come to the wrong place. They really did everything they could and really wanted to help, but it was not up to them.
I really should have arrived earlier!
I also owe a special debt of gratitude to the colleagues working at the reception, as they were also incredibly kind and helpful even during the first phone call.
Unfortunately, this story ended sadly, but apart from that, I wholeheartedly recommend the clinic to everyone.
Fast, precise endoscopic intervention, Leo and I are very grateful to Dr. András Faluvégi!🧸 …

They saved our Tacsinka❤️
Super, professional team.
Dr. András Faluvégi is the best doctor.
We are very grateful! We only turn to the Gizmók team every time.
Thank you for being with us!
They are very kind and helpful. I can only recommend them!
While on vacation with my greyhound, he hurt himself. We rushed there and they treated us incredibly well. Thank you for making yourselves understandable.
It's terrible, I don't recommend it to anyone. Unfortunately, they only care about money, not the animals at all.

Unfortunately, our 4-month-old beagle puppy got a tick in his nose. We arrived in the morning for the opening, and it was removed in about an hour and a half. The doctor and the assistants were both kind and direct, and by the afternoon the puppy's life was back in full swing. Thank you very much for this.

Dear Gizmók team!

I would like to express my gratitude for all that you have done for my little dog in the past period. The humanity, empathy and caring love that we received from the assistant and doctor team is certainly not experienced in many places. Szotyika became a patient of the clinic in her old age, but I think we can thank the Gizmók team that we were able to have many happy months together despite her complex illness. Dr. Balázs Bence closely monitored her condition, always keeping in mind how he could help the little old man. I would especially like to thank you for always being fair and compassionate.
We let her go in tears on her 17th birthday, but the entire staff of the clinic stood by us as one person.

I can wholeheartedly recommend the clinic to anyone who cares that their little pet receives a dedicated attitude and real care.

Thank you very much,
Tamás Melinda
Szotyi

You saved our dog's life!!
Elsewhere they would have cut open his stomach (which he wouldn't have survived) because there was a blockage in his throat...
Thanks again

The worst experience of my life, the deplorable communication and attitude of András Faluvégi, including the professional and ethical part. Unfortunately, we came to him with our cat on a recommendation, all that was needed was to find out what the diagnosis could be, a completely unnecessary diagnostic operation was also performed, torturing our cat, although a three-dimensional X-ray was taken, which later turned out during a second opinion that what Faluvégi assumed and on which he based the diagnostic operation could be ruled out with complete certainty.

After the operation, when we went to pick up our cat, he was put on the edge of the noisy, crowded reception desk in the carrier, exposed to infection and the stress caused by the other animals waiting there and the noises, rest was not provided. When we asked for the camera recordings several times, which would have confirmed our claim, they did not even bother to answer.

We left a lot more money in the clinic than we should have, we contacted another person who left a 1 rating, and he said that Faluvégi overcharges the owners on sight, which we completely agree with.

If you can, avoid the area around the clinic, and András Faluvégi even further away.

Update 2025.05.27:
During the hearing we initiated, conducted by the First Instance Ethics Committee of the Hungarian Veterinary Chamber, Faluvégi was convicted, as it turned out, had already happened once before in 2022.

I went to the Gizmók team on a recommendation, and they accepted me at first, which was very positive (although my dog ​​turned out to be an emergency).
They immediately started the surgery, which improved the condition, but the diagnosis and histology that followed did not give good news.
They said the results would take three weeks. I waited patiently, but unfortunately my dog's symptoms returned, so I was very worried.
I called them after two weeks and it turned out that the results had come in, they only speak to everyone one by one.
In the meantime, a medicine was also missed, which may not have helped, but it had been paid for and I had a lot of money that I left there at one time.
They did not call me back, even though this was the agreement and I indicated that I was very worried.
The next day I went in and the doctor told me the bad news, and when I went in he was overly kind, I felt that something was wrong.
Then he said this is not a phone call, it's good that I went.
I'll sign this too, but this wasn't the agreement before and the receptionist didn't even mention going in. I did all this on my own, and then I had to pay a consultation fee. I was very sad and disappointed.
Of course, the situation dictated it, and I couldn't do anything about it at the time.
About two months have passed and I still think the same, and it's not that I got bad news, but that it's unethical and inhumane in my opinion, I understand that it's about animals.
I'm writing all this because I don't have any intention of discrediting anyone, because I didn't experience anything bad professionally, but rather I felt a great lack of humanity and communication. I don't know if it's because of the overload, but unfortunately I was disappointed.
I hope that this doesn't cause problems for others, and they think about how it would be if they were in my place in such a case.

The whole place is exemplary. Clean and tidy waiting room. Friendly staff. A doctor who works with heart and soul (Dr. Balázs Bence).
No rush, no hurry.
They pay attention to every little thing. Thank you ♥️

We visited the clinic with an emergency and were completely satisfied. Dr. Gizella Hajnalka welcomed us, then Dr. Balázs Bence continued the care.
